corrected_code:
class SmartApplianceConsumer(AsyncWebsocketConsumer):
    async def receive(self, text_data):
        data = json.loads(text_data)
        device_eui = data.get('device_eui')
        is_owner = await database_sync_to_async(
            SmartAppliance.objects.filter(device_eui=device_eui, owner=self.scope['user']).exists
        )()
        if not is_owner:
            await self.send(text_data=json.dumps({'error': 'Unauthorized device control'}))
            return
        new_state = data.get('power_state')
        await mqtt_client.publish(f"devices/{device_eui}/set_power", json.dumps({'state': new_state}))
        await self.send(text_data=json.dumps({'acknowledged': True, 'device': device_eui}))
